brief: Football (soccer) club management & match game UI suite — landscape 1920x1080, dynamic broadcast-grade sports style.

pages.role: Main menu — team brand, player profile, big START MATCH entry, secondary entries (lineup/season/shop).
Lineup — on-field formation diagram with player slots, selectable player list, team overall rating, tactic selection.
Player detail — portrait, six-stat ability bars, growth & training entries, contract/status info.
Match HUD — both-side score + crests, match clock, possession/substitution/tactic buttons, key-event ticker.
Post-match result — final score, MVP, data stats (shots/possession% etc.), rewards, next-match entry.

styleAxes.mood: Dynamic broadcast-grade pro football: energetic, confident, stadium-night atmosphere.
styleAxes.accent: Electric pitch-green (#26E07F) + amber spotlight (#FFC53D) on deep midnight navy (#0B1220).
styleAxes.density: Medium-high: rich data cards and HUD chrome, but with clear hierarchy and generous breathing room around primary actions.
styleAxes.type: Bold condensed-feel sans for numerals/headlines, calm regular weight for body and labels; strong size contrast.
